tagline: All the makings of an Everlong Midnight
heroImageAlt: The Midnight Margarita Club box, candle, and glassware
insideParagraph1: Each TMMC member will receive handcrafted pieces, stone and botanical elements, ingredients for the evening, and a handful of Club traditions you’ll discover as the night unfolds.
insideParagraph2: Created, gathered, and chosen to accompany you through the night - from the first spark to last call.
insideParagraph3: Some things were made by hand while some were gathered. Some things will be gone by morning and others were made to stay with you for midnights to come.
insideClosingLine: Your place in the Club awaits.

items.title: A SPARK
items.description: Hand-poured pure beeswax candle to start your evening

items.alt: Ribbed glass tumbler for the Midnight Margarita
items.title: A LITTLE ATMOSPHERE
items.description: An aromatic blend of botanicals to fill the air

items.title: A BIT OF MIDNIGHT
items.description: Seven tiny keepsakes gathered from the woods, garden, sky, night, the Club, and two sisters who know a thing or two about magic

items.title: A TOAST
items.description: A ritual with the Club's finishing touches - equally suited to margaritas or mocktails

items.title: AFTER HOURS
items.description: A digital extension of the Club, unlocked from inside your box

includesClosingLine: As for everything else? That's yours to discover

footNote2: Each TMMC box is thoughtfully assembled in small batches, exclusively for this drop. Minor variations are part of its handcrafted nature and make each box a little different. Because each box is made in limited quantities, all sales are final and we’re unable to accept returns or exchanges. If your order arrives damaged or something isn’t right, please contact us within 7 days of delivery.
